name: eject-device
title: Eject Device
description: Eject a connected iPhone or iPad and unmount external disks without leaving the keyboard.
author: gersonsebastianx

commands.name: eject-device
commands.title: Eject Device
commands.subtitle: Devices and disks
commands.description: List connected iPhones, iPads and mounted disks, and eject the one you pick.

commands.name: eject-all-disks
commands.title: Eject All Disks
commands.description: Unmount every ejectable disk at once. Leaves iPhones and iPads connected.

commands.name: diagnose-sidebar
commands.title: Diagnose Finder Sidebar
commands.description: Dump the accessibility tree of the Finder sidebar to troubleshoot device detection.

preferences.name: ignoredItems
preferences.title: Ignored Items
preferences.description: Comma-separated names to hide from the list, for disks you never want to eject by accident.

preferences.name: closeAfterEject
preferences.title: Window
preferences.label: Close Raycast after ejecting
preferences.description: Close the Raycast window as soon as an eject is triggered.
